title: SPnT
text: Single pole multiple throw switch, 1 input; {Insertion loss (dB)} sets the insertion loss of switch, {Isolation (dB)} sets the isolation value of switch, {Loading type} sets the switch type, {Number of outputs}, {Port terminations (Ohm)} and {Ground and hide reference terminals} sets the ground RF circuit terminals. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Number of outputs
params.values: Number of outputs for switch 2 (default) | scalar

params.name: Ground and hide reference terminals
params.values: Ground RF circuit terminals on (default) | off
